headline: Workshops on updates to the Zoning Ordinance, Land Development and Subdivision Regulations, and Comprehensive Plan, plus votes to appoint two administrative officers.
summary: The meeting includes status updates on zoning and subdivision rule changes needed to match state law. It also covers early steps in updating the Comprehensive Plan. No vote will be taken on these workshop items.

INFORMATIONAL PUBLIC MEETING 
 
Workshop 
Text Amendments to the Zoning Ordinance             (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is in the process of updating the Zoning Ordinance in 
response to recent legislative updates to Rhode Island General Laws. The proposed changes will 
bring the Zoning Ordinance into compliance with these legislative updates and address 
inconsistencies, errors, and omissions in the existing Zoning Ordinance. This agenda item provides a 
status update on the in-progress Zoning Ordinance update and a timeline for future Planning 
Commission workshops.  
 
Workshop 
Text Amendments to the Land Development and Subdivision Regulations   (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is in the process of updating the Land Development and 
Subdivision Regulations in response to recent legislative updates to Rhode Island General Laws. The 
proposed changes will bring the Land Development and Subdivision Regulations into compliance 
with these legislative updates and address inconsistencies, errors, and omissions in the existing 
Zoning Ordinance. This agenda item provides a status update on the in-progress Land Development 
and Subdivision Regulations update and a timeline for future Planning Commission workshops.  
 
Workshop 
Comprehensive Plan Update                       (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is in the preliminary stages of updating the 
Comprehensive Plan to better align with community sentiment, updates to Rhode Island General 
Laws, and recent revisions to several elements of the State Guide Plan. This agenda item provides 
context for the need to update the Comprehensive Plan and a basic overview of the process behind 
the update. 
 
I. Director’s Report                 (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
 
J. Adjournment
